handback.title: One settings file picks each role's agent and model
handback.summary: A settings file names each role's subscription and model, and every agent runs behind one interface.
handback.user_story: Each role runs on the subscription and model the owner names in one file; Claude Code works as today.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each repo keeps its agent settings in one file in its Dokima folder.
acceptance_criteria.words: One structured file per repo, `.dokima/agents.yml`
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Having no file at all is its own criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: A run's agent gets its key from the secret its role's subscription names.
acceptance_criteria.words: `subscriptions` (agent, key)
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A missing secret fails inside the agent, as today.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner, the worker and the reviewer each get their own subscription and model from the file.
acceptance_criteria.words: `roles` (planner, worker, reviewer: which subscription and model)
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Left-out roles and bad names are their own criteria.

acceptance_criteria.text: A role may name any model; Dokima keeps no list of allowed models.
acceptance_criteria.words: Any agent, any model: planner, worker and reviewer each pick theirs.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Any name passes; the agent itself refuses a model it lacks.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each run starts its role's agent on the model the file names.
acceptance_criteria.words: The file is just a simple declaration: which model is used for which stage.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Bad names and failing agents are their own criteria.

acceptance_criteria.text: With no settings file, every run starts Claude Code with today's model and key.
acceptance_criteria.words: No file means today's behavior.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: This criterion is itself the empty case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A role the file leaves out starts Claude Code with today's model and key.
acceptance_criteria.words: No file means today's behavior.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: This criterion is itself the empty case for one role.

acceptance_criteria.text: A role naming an unknown subscription stops the run before any agent starts.
acceptance_criteria.words: No fallback for now.

edge_cases.case: A role missing its model line, a normal typo, stops too, naming the role.

acceptance_criteria.text: The issue names the unknown subscription that stopped the run.
acceptance_criteria.words: No fallback for now.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It only follows a stop by criterion 698.8.

acceptance_criteria.text: A subscription naming an agent with no adapter stops the run before any agent starts.
acceptance_criteria.words: No fallback for now.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One case: an agent name with no adapter.

acceptance_criteria.text: The issue names the unknown agent that stopped the run.
acceptance_criteria.words: No fallback for now.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It only follows a stop by criterion 698.10.

acceptance_criteria.text: A run starts its role's agent through the one agent interface, by that agent's own adapter.
acceptance_criteria.words: The file and one agent interface

acceptance_criteria.text: Claude Code is installed through the one agent interface, as today.
acceptance_criteria.words: Claude Code moves behind it unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The install fails, as when the package cannot be fetched.

acceptance_criteria.text: Claude Code starts with today's command, flags and key.
acceptance_criteria.words: Claude Code moves behind it unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: A run's record names the models and stats its own agent reports.
acceptance_criteria.words: The file and one agent interface
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A run with no report is covered under 698.17.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Claude Code run's record names the same models as today.
acceptance_criteria.words: Claude Code moves behind it unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A log naming two models is the normal case tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Claude Code run's record shows the same stats as today.
acceptance_criteria.words: Claude Code moves behind it unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The agent stopped before printing its report.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Claude Code run's transcript reads the same as today, secrets removed.
acceptance_criteria.words: Claude Code moves behind it unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A secret in the log is the normal case tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: A role starts only its subscription's own agent, never another vendor's agent.
acceptance_criteria.words: No model runs inside another vendor's agent.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One case: a model named like another vendor's.

acceptance_criteria.text: Moving a role to another subscription takes one edit: that role's subscription line.
acceptance_criteria.words: It exposes a simple interface for deciding the orchestration across subscriptions.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Bad names after an edit are criterion 698.8.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a role's agent fails, the run fails; no other subscription takes over.
acceptance_criteria.words: No fallback for now.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: This criterion is itself the error case.

non_functional.text: Subscriptions and roles sit in their own sections, so other settings can join the file.
non_functional.why: The owner expects the file to hold other settings later.
non_functional.words: Later it may expand into other settings.
non_functional.no_edge_cases: Other sections are the case itself.

test_changes.tests/test_start.py::FAKE_CLAUDE: The fake agent logs the model from --model and keeps its arguments.
test_changes.tests/test_start.py::Machine: Machine can commit extra files on main, such as a settings file.
test_changes.tests/test_start.py::Run: Run can add repo secrets, so a run can use another key.
test_changes.tests/test_live_queue.py::FAKE_CLAUDE_AN: The fake agent logs the model from --model, as Claude Code does.
test_changes.tests/test_one_order.py::WORKER: The fake agent logs the model from --model, as Claude Code does.

answers.why: New run test puts the reviewer on a stand-in agent; its adapter must run, Claude Code never.
The install test now also runs the workflow with the stand-in agent and a broken npm.
Split into stopping and naming for each bad name, and models, stats and transcript, one test each.
New edge case: a role with no model line stops, naming the role, with no agent started.
